subject: Leadership availability and calendar handoff for architecture readout
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
To: James Sullivan <james.sullivan@oriondatasys.com>, Emily Cho <emily.cho@oriondatasys.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Architecture deep-dive readout — leadership attendance?

Hi James / Emily —

Thanks again for the time last week. As discussed, we'd like to run a 60–75 minute technical readout to walk through the proposed integration architecture, authentication model (KMS/HSM options), and scaling profile for your projected Q1 traffic. We find these sessions are much more productive when the customer exec sponsor (CTO/Head of Platform) and our exec sponsor are both present for the high-level decisions.

Do you anticipate your CTO or Head of Platform being available the week of Oct 12? Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue Oct 13: 10:00–11:15
- Wed Oct 14: 14:00–15:15
- Thu Oct 15: 09:00–10:15

If those don't work, flag a couple of windows and we will try to accommodate. Attendees from our side: myself, Lauren Bishop (Solutions Lead), Markus Klein (Platform Sponsor, will join for the exec portion), and Dev Patel (SRE/ops).

Attached: draft_agenda_v2.pdf (high-level topics + prep ask).

Goal for the meeting: align on integration pattern, expected P95 latency targets, and decision on whether Dedicated or Private deployment is preferable for your security posture.

Quick ask: if you can confirm whether an exec (CTO/Head of Platform) will attend, we will lock the calendar and circulate a final agenda.

Thanks —
Aisha
Aisha Rahman | Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0128 | aisha_rahman@redwood.ai
From: James Sullivan <james.sullivan@oriondatasys.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emily Cho <emily.cho@oriondatasys.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-07T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Architecture deep-dive readout — leadership attendance?

Hi Aisha —

Thanks for the clear agenda. We agree in principle that having leadership there will help accelerate decisions. Quick update from our side: our CTO is traveling Oct 13–14 and not available those days. Head of Platform (Emily) can cover the technical side but she'll need her director in the room for exec-level decisions.

Alternative windows that look promising for our execs:
- Fri Oct 16: 11:00–12:15 PT
- Mon Oct 19: 09:30–10:45 PT

If it's easier, we can run the technical deep-dive with Emily and her director on Oct 14 (technical-only), and then have a separate 30-minute exec alignment the following week to land the final decision — that would split the meeting but might be the least disruptive for schedules.

Attaching org_chart_orion.pdf so you can see who would be there.

Also, can Markus act as the Redwood exec sponsor for the condensed exec alignment? If so, we can lock Oct 19 09:30 PT.

—James
James Sullivan
VP, Product Engineering | Orion Data Systems
james.sullivan@oriondatasys.com
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>, James Sullivan <james.sullivan@oriondatasys.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-07T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Architecture deep-dive readout — leadership attendance?

Aisha / team —

Thanks for the note, James. Quick internal check: Markus can cover as exec sponsor but his calendar is tight. He has a confirmed 10:00 PT hold on Fri Oct 16 that we can move to 11:00 PT if needed. Given Orion's CTO travel, my recommendation is:

Option A (preferred): Technical deep-dive w/ Emily + director on Thu Oct 14 (we run a deep technical session), followed by a 30-minute exec alignment with Markus + Orion execs on Mon Oct 19 09:30–10:00 PT to finalize the deployment choice.

Option B: Single meeting Fri Oct 16 11:00–12:15 PT with Markus joining for the last 20 minutes for exec review — this keeps it as one meeting but compresses the decision window.

Notes: Dev can own the scalability segment and will prepare a short runbook of questions for Orion pre-read. I'll draft the split agenda if we go with Option A and circulate a calendar hold for Oct 14 + Oct 19.

LMK which option you prefer. If we confirm Option A, Aisha can send the two invites and we will update the agenda attachments (final_agenda_oct9.pdf will become final_agenda_oct14.pdf — dev, please review the scalability bullets).

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop | Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

Subject: Confirmed: Technical deep-dive on Oct 14 + exec alignment on Oct 19 (calendar holds sent)

Hi all —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Per the thread below, we'll run Option A:
1) Technical deep-dive — Thu Oct 14, 14:00–15:15 PT (Emily + director + engineering team, deep technical agenda).
2) Exec alignment — Mon Oct 19, 09:30–10:00 PT (Markus Klein + Orion execs) to finalize deployment choice and SLA targets.

I've sent two calendar invites (link below). Please accept and add any supporting docs to the shared agenda: https://docs.redwood.ai/shared/OR-2026-1143/agenda

Attachments: final_agenda_oct9.pdf (includes split agenda + pre-reads).

Action items before Oct 14:
- Orion: confirm director who will attend the technical session and add any additional pre-reads to the shared folder.
- Redwood (Dev): finalize the scalability section and send a 1-pager on KV cache recommendations by Oct 12.
- Lauren: circulate a slide with proposed success criteria for the exec alignment.

If anything changes on your side, reply here and we'll adjust. Looking forward to it.

Best —
Aisha
